plan_title: Fix PR Review Issues: Module Exports, State Mutation, and Audio Toggle Placement

steps.title: Export persistence and stage-advance functions from gameState.js
steps.description: Modify js/gameState.js to add saveToLocalStorage, loadFromLocalStorage, and advanceStage to the returned module object so they can be imported by app.js. The advanceStage function should increment state.currentStage directly on the internal state object (not a copy) and then call saveToLocalStorage(). Ensure the returned object includes: getGameState, setTeamName, saveToLocalStorage, loadFromLocalStorage, and advanceStage.

steps.title: Fix state mutation in app.js by using the new advanceStage import
steps.description: In js/app.js, update the import statement to import advanceStage from gameState.js instead of saveToLocalStorage. Remove the local advanceStage function definition (which incorrectly mutates a shallow copy from getGameState). The existing event listener 'btnStart.addEventListener('click', advanceStage)' will now reference the imported advanceStage from gameState.js, which correctly mutates the internal state and persists it.

steps.title: Add audio toggle button back into IntroScreen component's action bar
steps.description: In js/components/IntroScreen.js, add the audio toggle button HTML back into the .action-bar div within the render() template literal, restoring the original DOM hierarchy. The button should have: id='btn-audio-toggle', type='button', class='audio-toggle', aria-label='Toggle audio', aria-pressed='false', and contain a span with class 'audio-icon' containing the text '🔊'. Place it after the btn-start button inside .action-bar.

steps.title: Remove standalone audio toggle button from index.html
steps.description: In index.html, remove the standalone element that was placed as a direct child of . This element is now rendered by the IntroScreen component inside the action bar, so keeping it in HTML would cause a duplicate element and break the CSS layout that depends on the button being nested within .action-bar.
